summary: Rabbi Alouf discusses the structure of Leil Haseder, defining Jewish identity through Avraham Avinu, Yitzchak, and Yaakov, and addressing the root of anti-Semitism across generations. He praises the SCA boot camp initiative, highlighting the importance of education, connection to Torah, and pride in tradition for students facing anti-Semitism.
questions: What is the significance of Leil Haseder and Korban Pesah in Bet HaMikdash?
How do Avraham Avinu, Yitzchak, and Yaakov define Jewish identity?
Why does anti-Semitism take different forms in every generation?
How does education help strengthen identity for students going to college?
